svg.aria-label: AgriCycle: offline-first Bangla PWA for smallholder farmers with a farmer–buyer marketplace, crop-waste recycling matcher, green rewards and a Bangla farming advisor.
svg.title: AgriCycle: offline-first Bangla PWA for smallholder farmers with a farmer–buyer marketplace, crop-waste recycling matcher, green rewards and a Bangla farming advisor.

g.text: A mobile-first app for smallholder farmers in
Bangladesh: sell without middlemen, earn from crop
waste, get rewarded for green farming.
Farmer–buyer market, waste matcher, green rewards
Bangla advisor with voice, offline PWA, 64 districts
